baseline.source: canon: WFB 8e Warriors of Chaos (Kurgan, Hung, Kul and Tong marauder tribes of the eastern steppes: horse-raiders under warlords and Chaos shamans)
baseline.why: Loose marauder confederations under warlords with Chaos shamans; no schooling, police or bureaucracy; tribal package at tier 7; Kurgan tribes follow their chieftains (law_chiefdom; no effect until the tags are defined, #9037)

HUN.note: Confederation baseline unchanged; canon gives names of tribes, not institutions (a confederation law variant is a mechanics gap).

KUL.note: Asavar Kul's host from the Great War against Chaos; baseline unchanged.
